creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, 2026-10-01: "naming pane syncs into agent harness task name?" Clarified 2026-10-03: both ways.

When a pane is renamed (chord, menu, `muster pane rename`, `pane new --name`), the agent running in it takes the same name as its session name - for Claude Code, what `/rename` sets and `/resume` lists. And when the harness names or renames its session, the pane takes that name. Open: how to deliver a rename into a harness without typing into a busy prompt (the msg doorbell rules are the precedent), how to learn of a harness-side rename (hooks, statusline, transcript), and loop prevention. Harness-agnostic per the desiderata: a per-harness adapter, Claude Code first.
title: 🏷️ Naming a pane names the agent's session in its harness
